# milim

> milim is an MIT-licensed local control plane for coding agents.

Use your own hosted models, local runtimes, and account subscriptions while keeping workspace context, tool history, artifacts, approvals, and diffs in one canonical development thread.

## Links

- Website: https://milim.ai/
- Documentation: https://docs.milim.ai/
- Quickstart: https://docs.milim.ai/quickstart
- Models and providers: https://docs.milim.ai/models
- Privacy: https://docs.milim.ai/privacy
- GitHub: https://github.com/bildhaus/milim
- Latest release: https://github.com/bildhaus/milim/releases/latest
